about: West Perth is a municipality in Perth County, Ontario, centred on Mitchell—not Stratford, and not a city. A farm-service downtown, cheese-country heritage, and surrounding concessions define this inland agricultural municipality. About 9,000 people live in West Perth.
seoSummary: Perth County municipality around Mitchell—farm-service town and cheese country, not Stratford.
knownFor: Municipality centred on Mitchell, not a city
